verses.98:1: لَمۡ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ

meaning: The root فكك primarily means to separate, loosen, or disjoin something that was bound or joined. It can refer to freeing a captive, disentangling, or solving a problem.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic root occurring exactly twice.
